ticket_window_local.timezone_note: Internet2 GRNOC publishes ticket times in US Eastern time. EDT = UTC−4.

target.label: RIPE via NYIIX

provenance.statement: Reviewed transit mapping: AS11537 = Internet2 (the network conducting the maintenance). Single-ASN legacy shortcut converted to canonical ContainsAny predicate.

target.prefix_selection: origin AS3333 AND baseline AS path contains AS11537
target.prefix_selection_provenance: Manual analyst mapping: AS3333 = RIPE NCC (the peer named in the ticket); AS11537 = Internet2 (the network conducting the maintenance). We select only prefixes originated by RIPE whose pre-event baseline path traverses Internet2, as those are the routes that could be affected by the NYIIX/NEWA attachment outage.

collectors_provenance: RouteViews peers with broad global visibility. Selected for IPv4 coverage of AS3333 prefixes.
analyst_notes: The ticket title 'Brief Outage - I2 PX Peer RIPE via NYIIX (NEWA)' indicates a short incident affecting the RIPE peer's New York attachment (site code NEWA). The parenthesized site code convention implies expected redundancy: one attachment may be unavailable, but RIPE reachability through Internet2 should remain via alternate paths.
Event window is 22 minutes (05:25–05:47 EDT). We add 60 minutes of warm-up before and cool-down after to observe baseline, transition, and restoration.

Prefixes are selected by scanning the preceding RIB for origin AS3333 routes whose AS path contains AS11537 (Internet2). This is a manual selection — no automatic participant-to-ASN mapping is performed.

Broker discovery is used to locate RIB and UPDATE files; caching avoids repeated downloads. If broker is unreachable or archives are unavailable, the analysis will report INSUFFICIENT_VISIBILITY or an archive error.
